Package dev.swordai.core.nn

package dev.swordai.core.nn
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Adam
    Adam with global-norm gradient clipping.
    Conv2d
    Valid (unpadded) 2-D convolution over channel-last maps: index = (y * width + x) * channels + c.
    Dense
    Fully connected layer.
    Param
    One trainable tensor, stored flat, together with its Adam moments.
    ParamSet
    All parameters of one network.
    ResBlock
    A residual feed-forward block, x + W2 relu(W1 LN(x)), the building block SimBa (Lee et al., ICLR 2025) scales reinforcement-learning networks with: the layer norm keeps what the block sees at one scale however the network below it grows, and the skip path keeps a plain way through.
